name: Ruchi Infrastructure Limited
about: Ruchi Infrastructure Limited engages in the infrastructure business in India. It operates through Commodities, Infrastructure, Wind Energy, and Others segments. The company operates liquid storage facilities for handling bulk storage of liquid commodities, such as edible oils, petroleum products, bitumen, paraffins, and liquid chemicals; and warehousing facilities, including storing agri commodities comprising wheat, maize, soybean, cotton, chana etc., as well as customized warehousing facility for various industries, such as FMCG, E-commerce, cement, white goods, soap, adhesive, paint, etc. It also trades in various commodities and operates wind energy projects. The company was formerly known as Ruchi Infrastructure and Finance Ltd and changed its name to Ruchi Infrastructure Limited in June 1995. Ruchi Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Indore, India.
